Class StandardScriptFactory

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scripting.support.StandardScriptFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, ScriptFactory
public class StandardScriptFactory extends Object implements ScriptFactory, BeanClassLoaderAware
ScriptFactory implementation based on the JSR-223 script engine abstraction (as included in Java). Supports JavaScript, Groovy, JRuby, and other JSR-223 compliant engines.

通常与 ScriptFactoryPostProcessor 结合使用；请参阅后者的 Javadoc 以获取配置示例。

Since:
4.2
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller
See Also:

    • getScriptSourceLocator

      public String getScriptSourceLocator()
      描述从接口复制：ScriptFactory
      Return a locator that points to the source of the script. Interpreted by the post-processor that actually creates the script.

      典型支持的定位器是 Spring 资源位置（例如 "file:C:/myScript.bsh" 或 "classpath:myPackage/myScript.bsh"）和内联脚本（"inline:myScriptText..."）。

      Specified by:
      `getScriptSourceLocator` 接口 `ScriptFactory` 中
      Returns:
      脚本源定位器
      See Also:
      • ScriptFactoryPostProcessor.convertToScriptSource(String, String, ResourceLoader)
      • ResourceLoader

    • getScriptedObjectType

      public @Nullable Class<?> getScriptedObjectType(ScriptSource scriptSource) throws IOException, ScriptCompilationException
      描述从接口复制：ScriptFactory
      Determine the type of the scripted Java object.

      实现者应缓存脚本元数据，例如生成的脚本类。请注意，此方法可能并发调用，必须以线程安全的方式实现。

      Specified by:
      `getScriptedObjectType` 接口 `ScriptFactory` 中
      Parameters:
      scriptSource - 用于检索脚本源文本的实际 ScriptSource（绝不null）
      Returns:
      脚本化 Java 对象的类型，或者如果无法确定则为 `null`。
      Throws:
      `IOException` - 如果脚本检索失败
      ScriptCompilationException - 如果脚本编译失败
